one_line: A young Yuezhi clan leader during their migration and settlement in Bactria, c. 2nd–1st century BCE.

appearance.age_look: mid-20s, athletic and wiry, used to long rides and harsh steppe weather
appearance.face: oval face with high cheekbones, straight nose, light olive-to-fair Central Asian complexion, sharp dark brows, focused almond eyes, faint windburn on cheeks, default expression calm but alert with a subtle, strategic half‑smile
appearance.hair: thick straight dark brown hair, shoulder‑length, tied high into a short topknot at the crown and the rest pulled back with a narrow red wool headband; no helmet, but a simple felt cap in dull brown sometimes pushed back behind the topknot
appearance.costume: long‑sleeved, hip‑length wool tunic in muted deep red with simple darker geometric trim at cuffs and hem, worn over a cream‑coloured linen under‑shirt; narrow leather belt in dark brown with small bronze fittings securing a dagger sheath and pouch; close‑fitting riding trousers in dark teal‑blue wool tucked into mid‑calf soft leather boots in warm brown; over this, a sleeveless riding coat in undyed light beige felt, knee‑length, with a wrap front and a plain woven border in faded indigo, usually worn open to show the red tunic; a light, rectangular wool cloak in dull indigo draped over shoulders and fastened by a small round bronze brooch on the right side; minimal jewellery—one simple bronze ring and a thin plaited leather bracelet on the left wrist.
appearance.signature: a slightly recurved composite steppe bow with a pale wood grip, dark horn belly, and sinew backing, carried unstrung in the left hand, with a matching leather quiver of feathered arrows slung at the right hip beside a short, broad‑bladed iron dagger in a plain brown leather sheath.

ref_desc: A young Greater Yuezhi yabghu with an oval, fair Central Asian face, shoulder‑length dark brown topknotted hair with red headband, deep red tunic, cream shirt, dark teal trousers, beige felt coat, indigo cloak, leather boots, and a recurved composite bow with hip quiver and dagger.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style model of a young Greater Yuezhi clan leader standing confidently: an oval‑faced Central Asian rider with high cheekbones, light olive‑fair skin, sharp brows and calm, alert eyes. His thick straight dark brown hair is shoulder‑length, tied into a high topknot, with a narrow red wool headband circling the crown and a simple dull brown felt cap pushed back behind the knot. He wears a muted deep red hip‑length wool tunic with long sleeves and darker geometric trim on cuffs and hem over a cream linen under‑shirt visible at the collar and wrists. A dark brown leather belt with small bronze fittings holds a plain pouch and a short, broad‑bladed iron dagger in a brown leather sheath at his hip. His close‑fitting dark teal‑blue wool riding trousers are tucked into mid‑calf warm brown soft leather boots suitable for steppe riding. Over the tunic he has a sleeveless, knee‑length light beige felt riding coat with a wrap front and a simple faded indigo woven border, worn open so the red tunic shows, and a dull indigo rectangular wool cloak drapes from his shoulders, fastened on the right side with a small round bronze brooch. He carries his signature recurved composite steppe bow unstrung in his left hand, showing a pale wood grip with dark horn belly and sinew backing, while a matching leather quiver of feathered arrows hangs at his right hip beside the dagger. Keep the palette to deep red, cream, dark teal blue, indigo, warm brown, and beige, and emphasize historically grounded Central Asian nomad clothing with clean anime lines and heroic but dignified energy.
